messages.subject: image legend cut
parts:
Hi,

for images created with the image() function it seems that for large intensities the numbers in the legend are not fully displayed.

See attached image. Is there an easy fix?

Cheers,
Melanie

messages.author: fed6dfe7aa6440f2
messages.subject: Re: image legend cut
parts: I have had the same problem. After click export and image, you have the possibility to enlarge the picture (you will see some double arrow down right) and you will see the other digits of the intensity values or you simply export as pdf and choose landscape as orientation.

messages.author: db2a70d9b31cb1f7
messages.subject: Re: image legend cut
parts:
Thank you that gave me the right hint :)

In my script I needed to adjust the margins - then the full legend is shown:
pdf("test.pdf")
par(oma=c(0,0,0,1))
image(ex_cont, mz=350)
dev.off()
